summary: Install-time and require-time beacon to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint from no-op shim package
details: The package ships a `postinstall` hook (`node beacon.cjs`) and a `main` (`index.js`) that both invoke `beacon.cjs`. The beacon POSTs host identifiers — package name, `os.hostname()`, install path (`__dirname`), `process.cwd()`, and `process.version` — to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint `http://13.140.137.222:8787/_ah/dc` over plain HTTP. The destination is not a publisher domain and is not caller-configurable. The `main` module exports a Proxy whose every property returns a no-op function, so the package provides no functionality and exists solely to fire the beacon on install and on first `require()`. The name, no-op surface, and install-time reconnaissance to an attacker-controlled bare IP are consistent with a dependency-confusion / install-recon probe.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
